Name: Waiting Ghost npc
Author: Graymize1
Description:
[center][size=6]The Waiting Ghost
[/size]
Adds a Ghost to the bus stop who is waiting for his wife to come back.
He waits forever but she never comes and he doesn't realize he is even dead.
There are no missions or anything to do with this mod. It just adds a npc to the town for a little variety!

He stays there all year every year.
He doesnt care for any gifts or anything[/center][center]﻿[/center]
